rule.name: AssertNotNullWrongCheck
rule.message: The Spring methods Assert.notNull and Assert.isNull test for null, but this call checks something else: a boolean or number is boxed and never null, and a String, Collection or Map whose message says empty or blank passes when it is empty. The assertion always holds and the invalid value goes through. Test the condition with Assert.isTrue(count >= 0, "count must not be negative"), and use Assert.hasText(name, "name must not be empty"), Assert.hasLength or Assert.notEmpty for text and collections. Assert.notNull(name, "name must not be null") on its own is fine.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('org.springframework.util.Assert#notNull(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.springframework.util.Assert#isNull(_*)')] [ArgumentList/*[1][ pmd-java:typeIs('boolean') or pmd-java:typeIs('int') or pmd-java:typeIs('long') or pmd-java:typeIs('double') or pmd-java:typeIs('float') or pmd-java:typeIs('short') or pmd-java:typeIs('byte') or pmd-java:typeIs('char') or self::UnaryExpression[@Operator = '!'] or self::InfixExpression[@Operator = ('==', '!=', '<', '>', '<=', '>=', '&&', '||')] or self::InstanceOfExpression] or @MethodName = 'notNull' and ArgumentList/@Size = 2 and ArgumentList/*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess or self::MethodCall] [pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.CharSequence') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Collection') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')] and ArgumentList/*[2][self::StringLiteral][matches(@Image, '(not|n.t|never|or|nor|be|is|are) +(be +)?([Ee]mpty|[Bb]lank)([^a-z]|$)')]]
